observations: Both Scene and Game contain actual FlappyBird title, bird, pipes, scenery and ground; no blank placeholder viewport was accepted.
Major docking boundaries, tabs, scene tool column, hierarchy rows and empty Inspector remain recognizable and aligned.
Main menu is intentionally organized as File/Edit/View/Window/Tools; Stats adds the planned numeric trends within its existing scrolling owner.
Completed replay reports 1827 triangles, zero unavailable GPU commands and zero unexecuted callbacks.
limits: Native triangle/atlas replay with actual GPU viewport texture readback; not a physical screenshot or final-backbuffer capture.
One matching full-product layout/content pair; other scales and inputs are separate real-context simulated-metric contracts.
No physical monitor/DPI, OS IME, manual usability or local Mac acceptance is inferred.
Single screenshot FPS/delta values are not performance evidence; controlled repeated measurements remain required.

performanceReview.decision: The only initial flags concern the same graph tail, where ten measured frames make P95 the maximum. A predeclared additional five alternating process pairs used the unchanged existing fixture with its normal five repetitions (50 measured frames/process). No pair exceeds +10% for P95; median P95 ratio 0.976476, CPU ratio 0.921875, frame median ratio 1.010766 and allocation ratio 0.737942. The initial +19.98% observation remains in the report, not erased or called a passing initial trial. No persistent >10% CPU/P95 or hot allocation regression is established under this repeatability criterion.

otherReview: Every other initial comparison was reviewed, including all paired values and scope; no repeatability flag remains.
Process CPU zero for very short command batches is quantization, not a claimed 100% CPU gain.
Product first-application wall time, source-activation CPU-frame interval and complete-run main CPU have different scopes; child CPU/GPU completion/physical display are not inferred.
Current source-activation CPU-frame median is 56.65s versus 52.72s (+7.46%), within the stated repeatable >10% gate; retain the cost, not claim startup uniformly improved.
2k graph P95 around32ms is not a 60FPS guarantee; 10k asset search around73ms is an explicit search operation, not a steady-frame guarantee.
Ten absolute complete-inspection processes separately satisfy median<16ms/P95<25ms/<8MiB at the unchanged100ms policy; worst observedP95 24.5695ms has limited margin.

All initial outliers, GC counts, counts of work, raw timings and all followup outliers remain preserved. No best-run selection, fixture validation removal, timeout relaxation or source/API change was made.
